title: Refund Basis, Notice Period and Transfer Terms of the Mountain Dining Plans
content:
Every plan in the Mountain Dining Plans range is sold on a stated refund basis, with its own administration fee, its own refund window counted in calendar days after the plan is opened, and its own notice period counted in calendar days before the requested end date by which a cancellation must be recorded. Whether the plan may be moved to a different household account, and what that costs, is a further condition of the plan. The conditions in force are these.

## Refund basis, administration fee, window and notice

| Plan | Refund basis | Administration fee retained | Refund window | Notice before the requested end date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | no refund | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | loaded amount less bonus | $25.00 | 30 calendar days | 7 calendar days |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | loaded amount less bonus | $35.00 | 45 calendar days | 14 calendar days |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | loaded amount less bonus | $75.00 | 60 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | full balance | $150.00 | 90 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | full balance | $0.00 | 120 calendar days | 60 calendar days |

## Moving a plan to a different household account

| Plan | May be moved to another household account | Fee for the move |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | no | $0.00 |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | no | $0.00 |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | no | $0.00 |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | yes | $95.00 |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | yes | $195.00 |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | yes | $0.00 |

## Notes on the two periods

The refund window and the notice period are counted from different points and answer different questions: the window is counted in calendar days after the plan was opened, while the notice period is counted in calendar days before the end date the household asks for. On the Alpine Club Dining Membership the window of 60 calendar days is twice the notice period of 30 calendar days, and the two still run from opposite ends of the plan's life; on the Peak Plate Dining Plan the window of 30 calendar days is more than four times the notice period of 7 calendar days. On the Mountain Bites Dining Card both stand at 0 calendar days. Of the three memberships that may be moved between household accounts, the Collective Hospitality Dining Membership is the only one that carries no fee for the move.
